title: Fleet-Assisted Risk-Threshold Recalibration with a Local Non-Bypass Guarantee for Connected Automated Vehicles: code and data
description: Code, derived risk pools and result files for the manuscript 'Fleet-Assisted Risk-Threshold Recalibration with a Local Non-Bypass Guarantee for Connected Automated Vehicles'. Implements information-flow isolation: fleet information enters only the fast adaptation channel, while a strictly local window-quantile ceiling sets the runtime gate. v1.0.6 adds the Matched Local Self-Blending control, which separates the self-blending effect from the value of collaboration.
